_about: Settings of the Whose Dime charts and assembly (S07): the one place for every number they use (audit C5). Colours come from whosedime/common/palette.json, file names of the video folder from whosedime/common/settings.json. Change a value here, by pull request to main; the report of each render records the values it used.
_timing_source: card_s: step4_scenes.md (cards about 2.5 s, not spoken). cut_lead_s: a scene changes 0.25 s before its first word, inside the pause (assumed). crossfade_s, fade_in_s, end_hold_s, fade_out_s: Zehon monter.py (0.6, 0.3, 1.5, 1.0 s), crossfade shortened to 0.5 s (assumed: the Whose Dime scenes are shorter). image_max_s: a still on screen longer is warned (Zehon: 10 s; 9-10 s scenes here, so 12 s, assumed). coverage_min: a scene found at less than 60 % in the voice is warned (Zehon rule, kept)
_motion_source: Zehon monter.py (5 % zoom, 6 % pan, source 10 % larger, clip slowed to 1.35x then frozen); chart_zoom: a 2 % push-in, charts carry little motion (assumed)
_on_screen_source: assumed (S07): keyword lower left on a navy band, 0.4 s after the scene starts, kept to its end
_audio_source: Zehon monter.py: YouTube reference loudness -14 LUFS, limiter at -1.5 dBTP
_check_source: Zehon monter.py controler(): the idea and thresholds come from preflight.py of the AI YouTube OS plugin (MIT): audio track present, no silence, no clipping, right size, right length
_chapters_source: step5_publication.md: 0:00 Cold open first, then one line per title and chapter card; YouTube needs at least 3 chapters of at least 10 s
_charts_source: checked by Franco, 2026-11-08 (S07c): the PNGs of Uber scenes 61, 70 and 82 opened full screen on his phone in portrait (model not named); after two rounds (label_size 46 -> 52 -> 58, small_size 30 -> 36 -> 42, icons_min_cell 36 -> 44) he said they read; source_size 26 not flagged. The figures of scene 61 stay 54 px (95 people in the grid; icons_max 50 would draw 950 as fewer figures than 15). Before (S07): sizes for 1920x1080 assumed to read on a phone; icons_max: a count is drawn as at most 100 figures (one figure = a power of ten, never written); bar_ratio_max: values further apart than 50x are shown as numbers without bars (a bar of $45 next to one of $8.1 billion says nothing)
_charts_tone_source: Franco, 2026-11-08 (S07b): a figure is coloured by meaning, not guessed. gain_words: gain green only for the company's money coming in; loss_words: loss coral only for money lost ('*' = any ending: bankrupt, bankruptcy); every other figure in navy ink, and in a compare with bars and neither gain nor loss, the last bar in mustard (the figure to look at). Franco, 2026-11-08 (D14, S07c): gain green and loss coral apply only to an amount of money (unit $); a count of people or a percentage stays navy ink, even next to 'bankrupt' or 'profit'. icons_gap: space between figures, as a share of the figure's cell (assumed); icons_min_cell: the smallest figure at 1920x1080, in px (S07b prompt); icons_max_cell: the largest (S07); icons_grid_share: the grid takes at most 60 % of the free height, the rest goes to its value and caption (assumed; S07 used 55 %). Franco, 2026-11-08 (D15, S07c): the values of two icons grids sit on one line, each grid standing on its value
